title: Minority rights, NCM and schemes
quote: Minority not defined in the Constitution; the State, not India, is the unit for minority status

boxes.title: Meaning & notified minorities
items: "Minority" ==**not defined** in the Constitution==; used in Arts **29, 30, 350A, 350B**
NCM Act **Sec. 2(c)**: community **notified by the Central Government**
**State** is the unit for status (**T.M.A. Pai, 2002**)
Linguistic minorities not notified → Special Officer (**Art. 350B**)

Special Officer for Linguistic Minorities; by **President** (**7th Amendment, 1956**)
